about: The English messages the Home story's people feature introduced (src/core/i18n/en.ts, people.*, #264), each with sample values. test/unit/i18n/moved-strings.test.ts asserts that the French catalog renders what the rewrite layer makes of the English, or what is `translated` where the layer leaves the English as it stood: the Home card's hint, a visible change that #268 records in its baselines. The legacy panel still draws all of these until #266 and #268, so no entry of the rewrite layer is deleted yet. Deleted with the layer in phase 4.
